title: Extra-curriculars poll
content: Hello again friends. This time my question is: Do you practice mental techniques NOT related to dreaming? (e.g. zazen or directed focus meditation, qigong, mnemonics, Hemi-Sync or binaural entrainment, therapeutic techniques like NLP or anxiety control methods, brain training exercises, etc). If so, for how long has your practice been active and how often do you practice? Thanks a lot.
